name: uc41_display
notes: Universal Controller 4.1 (Tip Charger) display - do NOT flash onto a Plasma StandAlone panel. 4.1.39B TEST BUILD: AUTO ON + AUTO OFF. Tips in fires plasma (no on/off cycling). Tips out: the plasma is switched off for a moment (up to 250 ms) and the sensor read while quiet (tips out 682, tips in 0) - done whenever a reading is above what tips-in gives (>95) and every 5 s - so pulling the tips stops the plasma, usually within ~1 s, at worst ~5 s. HARD CAP: plasma never stays on past the slider time + 0.5 s (blinking 888 if the cap had to act). STOP / serial stop / Test Plasma OFF still end the cycle. Keeps the main-loop fixes (smoothed power/vac flow, timer shut-offs, pump stays on). On-screen label still reads 4.1.38. Program only (.4XE), uSD untouched.
